items.exampleEn: The trainee pilot flew a small plane for the first time.
items.exampleZh: 那位見習飛行員第一次駕駛小飛機。

items.exampleEn: The team needs a mix of young players and veterans.
items.exampleZh: 這支球隊需要年輕球員和老將搭配。
items.glossZh: 老手；資深人員；退伍軍人

items.exampleEn: All personnel must wear a badge inside the building.
items.exampleZh: 所有人員在大樓內都必須配戴識別證。

items.exampleEn: The company gave him a gold watch on his retirement.
items.exampleZh: 他退休時，公司送了他一支金錶。

items.exampleEn: Her salary is paid on the last day of every month.
items.exampleZh: 她的薪水在每個月的最後一天發放。

items.exampleEn: Restaurant workers here earn an hourly wage plus tips.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的餐廳員工領時薪，另外還有小費。

items.exampleEn: The company dismissed two workers for stealing.
items.exampleZh: 公司因為偷竊解僱了兩名員工。

items.exampleEn: Her earnings from the shop are enough to support her family.
items.exampleZh: 她開店的收入足以養活一家人。

items.sentenceEn: The new trainees will spend their first week in the kitchen.
items.sentenceZh: 新來的實習生第一週會待在廚房。

items.audioEn: After forty years of teaching, my father is enjoying his retirement by the sea.
items.audioZh: 教了四十年書之後，我父親正在海邊享受退休生活。
items.questionZh: 說話者的父親退休後在做什麼？
options: Taking it easy near the beach

items.sentenceEn: He works two jobs because his wage is quite low.
items.sentenceZh: 他做兩份工作，因為他的工資相當低。

items.sentenceEn: The manager dismissed my idea without even listening to it.
items.sentenceZh: 經理連聽都沒聽就否定了我的點子。

items.stemEn: The company's ____ department is in charge of hiring new staff and planning training.
items.stemZh: 公司的人事部門負責招募新員工和規劃訓練。

items.stemEn: The new job offers a higher ____ and more holidays, so she is happy to change companies.
items.stemZh: 新工作提供更高的薪水和更多假期，所以她很樂意換公司。

items.passageEn: After thirty-five years at the same factory, Mr. Ho is a true veteran. Next month, he will begin his retirement, and the personnel office is planning a small party for him. Mr. Ho started as a trainee earning a very low wage, but he worked hard and became a supervisor. Over the years, his salary grew, and he saved part of his earnings every month. In all those years, the factory never had to dismiss a single worker, and Mr. Ho is proud of that. Now he wants to travel with his wife and spend more time with his family.
items.passageZh: 在同一家工廠工作了三十五年，何先生是個名副其實的老手。下個月他就要退休了，人事室正在為他籌備一場小型派對。何先生從工資很低的實習生做起，但他工作努力，後來當上了主管。這些年來，他的薪水逐漸增加，他每個月都會存下一部分收入。這些年來，工廠從來不必解僱任何一位員工，何先生對此感到很驕傲。現在他想和太太一起旅行，多花點時間陪家人。

questions.questionZh: 何先生剛進工廠時是什麼情況？
options: 是領很低工資的實習生

questions.questionZh: 何先生對工廠的哪一點感到驕傲？

items.promptZh: 這家公司今年的收入比去年高了百分之十。
referenceEn: The company's earnings this year are ten percent higher than last year.
This year, the company's earnings rose by ten percent compared with last year.
rubricZh: 比較的寫法不限（例如 ten percent higher than、rose by ten percent 等）
時態配合內容（例如 are、rose 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 retirement 造一個句子，說說你希望退休後做什麼，或你認識的人退休後在做什麼。
referenceEn: After my retirement, I hope to open a small bookshop.
I want to travel around the world after my retirement.
rubricZh: retirement 的用法，例如 after my retirement、in retirement、spend his retirement 等
時態合理（例如 hope、spends 等）
